shared.ageRating: 4+ (no objectionable content, no web access, nothing shared with other users)
shared.reviewNotes:
Nearclip keeps the clipboard of the user's own devices in sync on the local network. It has no account and no server, so there is nothing to sign in to.
To try it, run Nearclip on two devices on the same Wi-Fi: another iPhone, iPad or Mac, or the free Windows and Android apps from https://ivlis-studio.github.io/nearclip/. Choose Add Device: on iPhone or iPad scan the QR code shown on the Mac or PC (or paste its link); two Macs pair by comparing a 6-digit code. Then copy on one device: on iPhone and iPad tap Paste in Nearclip to send (iOS only lets an app read the clipboard when the user asks), and the clip appears on the other device.
"Remote connection" is optional: it signs in to the user's own Tailscale account to reach their devices on other networks. It is not needed to review the app.

en-US.subtitle: One clipboard for every device
en-US.promotionalText: Copy on your iPhone, paste on your Windows PC, Mac or Android phone, and back. No account, no server: your devices connect directly, end-to-end encrypted.
en-US.descriptionIOS:
Copy here. Paste there.
Nearclip is one clipboard for your iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows PC and Android phone, with no account, no server and end-to-end encryption.

Send the photo you just took on your iPhone straight to the clipboard of your Windows PC. Copy an address on your Mac and paste it on your iPhone. Text, links and images move between every device you own, whoever made it.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD
• Tap Paste in Nearclip to send what you copied. iOS lets an app read the clipboard only when you ask, so you stay in control.
• Clips from your other devices arrive while Nearclip is open, and it catches up the moment you open it.
• Your whole history in one place: search it, filter text, links and images, and pin what you reuse.
• A quiet note tells you where each clip came from, and big images show their progress as they arrive.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• There is no Nearclip server and no account. Your devices find each other on your Wi-Fi and connect directly.
• Everything is end-to-end encrypted with keys only your devices hold.
• Pair a phone by scanning a QR code. Delete a clip once and it is gone from every device.

ON DIFFERENT NETWORKS?
Turn on Remote connection and sign in with the same free Tailscale account on each device. Tailscale is built in: nothing else to install, no VPN to set up, and Wi-Fi stays preferred.

Get Nearclip for Mac, Windows and Android at ivlis-studio.github.io/nearclip. It is free, with no ads, and open source under the MIT License.
en-US.descriptionMac:
Copy here. Paste there.
Nearclip is one clipboard for your Mac, iPhone, iPad, Windows PC and Android phone, with no account, no server and end-to-end encryption.

Copy on your Mac and paste on your Windows PC. The sign-in code that came to your Android phone, or the photo you just took on your iPhone, lands on your Mac's clipboard, ready for Command-V.

ON YOUR MAC
• Nearclip lives in the menu bar. Copy as usual and the clip is already on your other devices.
• Press Control-Command-V for the history of every device: search it, filter text, links and images, and pin what you reuse.
• A quiet note tells you where each clip came from, and big images show their size and progress the moment they are copied on another device.
• Items your password manager marks private are never synced. Ignore apps or pause syncing at any time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• There is no Nearclip server and no account. Your devices find each other on your network and connect directly.
• Everything is end-to-end encrypted with keys only your devices hold.
• Pair a phone with a QR code, or another computer by comparing a 6-digit code. Delete a clip once and it is gone from every device.

ON DIFFERENT NETWORKS?
Turn on Remote connection and sign in with the same free Tailscale account on each device. Tailscale is built in: nothing else to install, no VPN to set up, and Wi-Fi stays preferred.

Get Nearclip for Windows, Android and iPhone at ivlis-studio.github.io/nearclip. It is free, with no ads, and open source under the MIT License.

ko.subtitle: 모든 기기를 하나의 클립보드로
ko.promotionalText: iPhone에서 복사하고 Windows PC, Mac, Android 폰에서 붙여넣으세요. 반대로도요. 계정도 서버도 없이, 기기끼리 바로 종단 간 암호화로 연결됩니다.
ko.descriptionIOS:
여기서 복사하고, 저기서 붙여넣기.
Nearclip은 iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows PC, Android 폰을 하나의 클립보드로 잇습니다. 계정도 서버도 없이, 종단 간 암호화로.

iPhone으로 방금 찍은 사진을 Windows PC 클립보드로 바로 보내세요. Mac에서 복사한 주소는 iPhone에서 붙여넣으면 됩니다. 텍스트, 링크, 이미지가 제조사와 상관없이 내 모든 기기 사이를 오갑니다.

iPhone과 iPad에서는
• 복사한 뒤 Nearclip에서 붙여넣기를 누르면 보내집니다. iOS는 사용자가 요청할 때만 앱이 클립보드를 읽게 해서, 언제 보낼지는 내가 정합니다.
• 다른 기기에서 보낸 클립은 Nearclip이 열려 있을 때 도착하고, 앱을 여는 순간 밀린 것까지 바로 받아 옵니다.
• 모든 기기의 기록을 한곳에서: 검색하고, 텍스트·링크·이미지로 골라 보고, 자주 쓰는 건 고정하세요.
• 클립이 어디서 왔는지 조용히 알려 주고, 큰 이미지는 받는 동안 진행률을 보여 줍니다.

처음부터 개인정보를 생각했습니다
• Nearclip 서버도, 계정도 없습니다. 같은 Wi-Fi의 기기끼리 서로를 찾아 바로 연결합니다.
• 모든 내용은 내 기기들만 가진 키로 종단 간 암호화됩니다.
• 휴대폰은 QR 코드 한 번이면 연결되고, 클립을 지우면 모든 기기에서 지워집니다.

네트워크가 다른가요?
원격 연결을 켜고 기기마다 같은 무료 Tailscale 계정으로 로그인하세요. Tailscale이 Nearclip에 들어 있어서 따로 설치할 것도, 설정할 VPN도 없고, Wi-Fi 연결이 항상 우선입니다.

Mac, Windows, Android용 Nearclip은 ivlis-studio.github.io/nearclip 에서 받으세요. 광고 없이 무료이며, MIT 라이선스로 공개된 오픈 소스입니다.
